+You are given a regular expression and one or more quoted vulnerable parts.
+1. Check whether every quoted part occurs character for character (as an exact substring) inside the regular expression.
+2. If every part occurs exactly, write the regular expression again, but write R instead of each part that comes with "-> exact safe replacement: `R`". Otherwise write the regular expression again unchanged.
+3. Put ^(?: in front of it and ) after it.
+Change nothing else. The answer is always the complete regular expression.
+
+Example
+Regex:
+```
+^(\w+\s?)+$$
+```
+Parts: `(\w+\s?)+` -> exact safe replacement: `(\w+(?:\s\w+)*\s?)`
+Answer:
+```
+^(?:^(\w+(?:\s\w+)*\s?)$$)
+```
+
+Example
+Regex:
+```
+^(\w+\s?)+$$
+```
+Parts: `([a-zA-Z0-9_]+[\s]?)+` -> exact safe replacement: `([a-zA-Z0-9_]+(?:[\s][a-zA-Z0-9_]+)*[\s]?)`
+Answer:
+```
+^(?:^(\w+\s?)+$$)
+```
+
+Example
+Regex:
+```
+\d+\.\d+[a-z]*
+```
+Parts: `\d+`, `[a-z]*`
+Answer:
+```
+^(?:\d+\.\d+[a-z]*)
+```

diff --git a/scripts/scalpel_to_thinking_steps.py b/scripts/scalpel_to_thinking_steps.py
index 9da0b69..0f2179e 100644
--- a/scripts/scalpel_to_thinking_steps.py
+++ b/scripts/scalpel_to_thinking_steps.py
@@ -1,13 +1,515 @@
 """Public policy hooks used by the upstream prompt constructor."""
 
+from itertools import product
+import re
+import warnings
+
 from parse_regex_scalpel import Result as ScalpelResult
 
+# A localized subpattern is shown to the model together with an exact,
+# unambiguous rewrite when one of a few well-known shapes is recognized.  A
+# rewrite is only offered after an exhaustive comparison on short strings shows
+# that it accepts exactly the same language as the subpattern.
+
+_PROBE = [chr(i) for i in range(256)]
+_CLASS_ESCAPES = "dDwWsS"
+
+
+class _Atom:
+    """A single-character matcher such as `a`, `\\.`, `\\d`, `[a-z]` or `.`."""
+
+    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
+        self.text = text
+        compiled = re.compile(text)
+        probe = _PROBE + [c for c in text if ord(c) > 255]
+        self.chars = frozenset(c for c in probe if compiled.fullmatch(c))
+
+    def render(self) -> str:
+        return self.text
+
+
+class _Group:
+    def __init__(self, opening: str, alternatives: list) -> None:
+        self.opening = opening
+        self.alternatives = alternatives
+
+    def render(self) -> str:
+        body = "|".join(_render_sequence(e) for e in self.alternatives)
+        return self.opening + body + ")"
+
+
+class _Repeat:
+    def __init__(self, item, low: int, high: int | None, suffix: str,
+                 text: str) -> None:
+        self.item = item
+        self.low = low
+        self.high = high
+        self.suffix = suffix
+        self.text = text
+
+    def render(self) -> str:
+        return self.item.render() + self.text
+
+
+class _Opaque:
+    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
+        self.text = text
+
+    def render(self) -> str:
+        return self.text
+
+
+def _render_sequence(items: list) -> str:
+    return "".join(e.render() for e in items)
+
+
+class _Parser:
+    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
+        self.text = text
+        self.i = 0
+
+    def parse(self) -> list:
+        alternatives = self.alternatives()
+        if self.i != len(self.text):
+            raise ValueError("unbalanced")
+        return alternatives
+
+    def alternatives(self) -> list:
+        result = [self.sequence()]
+        while self.i < len(self.text) and self.text[self.i] == "|":
+            self.i += 1
+            result.append(self.sequence())
+        return result
+
+    def sequence(self) -> list:
+        items: list = []
+        while self.i < len(self.text) and self.text[self.i] not in "|)":
+            item = self.atom()
+            items.append(self.quantifier(item))
+        return items
+
+    def quantifier(self, item):
+        text = self.text
+        start = self.i
+        if start >= len(text):
+            return item
+        c = text[start]
+        if c in "*+?":
+            low, high = {"*": (0, None), "+": (1, None), "?": (0, 1)}[c]
+            self.i += 1
+        elif c == "{":
+            m = re.compile(r"\{(\d*)(,?)(\d*)\}").match(text, start)
+            if m is None or (not m.group(1) and not m.group(3)):
+                return item
+            low = int(m.group(1) or 0)
+            if m.group(2):
+                high = int(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else None
+            else:
+                high = low
+            self.i = m.end()
+        else:
+            return item
+        suffix = ""
+        if self.i < len(text) and text[self.i] in "?+":
+            suffix = text[self.i]
+            self.i += 1
+        return _Repeat(item, low, high, suffix, text[start:self.i])
+
+    def atom(self):
+        text = self.text
+        c = text[self.i]
+        if c == "\\":
+            if self.i + 1 >= len(text):
+                raise ValueError("dangling escape")
+            d = text[self.i + 1]
+            if d in "xuU0" or d.isdigit():
+                m = re.compile(
+                    r"\\(x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}|U[0-9a-fA-F]{8}"
+                    r"|0[0-7]{0,2}|[1-9][0-9]*)"
+                ).match(text, self.i)
+                if m is None:
+                    raise ValueError("bad escape")
+                self.i = m.end()
+                if m.group(1)[0] in "123456789":
+                    return _Opaque(m.group(0))
+                return _Atom(m.group(0))
+            self.i += 2
+            if d in "bBAZ":
+                return _Opaque("\\" + d)
+            return _Atom("\\" + d)
+        if c == "[":
+            j = self.i + 1
+            if j < len(text) and text[j] == "^":
+                j += 1
+            if j < len(text) and text[j] == "]":
+                j += 1
+            while j < len(text) and text[j] != "]":
+                j += 2 if text[j] == "\\" else 1
+            if j >= len(text):
+                raise ValueError("unterminated class")
+            atom = _Atom(text[self.i:j + 1])
+            self.i = j + 1
+            return atom
+        if c == "(":
+            m = re.compile(
+                r"\((\?:|\?P<\w+>|\?<\w+>|\?=|\?!|\?<=|\?<!|\?[aiLmsux-]+:)?"
+            ).match(text, self.i)
+            if text.startswith("(?", self.i) and not m.group(1):
+                raise ValueError("unsupported group")
+            self.i = m.end()
+            opening = m.group(0)
+            alternatives = self.alternatives()
+            if self.i >= len(text) or text[self.i] != ")":
+                raise ValueError("unbalanced")
+            self.i += 1
+            group = _Group(opening, alternatives)
+            if opening in ("(?=", "(?!", "(?<=", "(?<!"):
+                return _Opaque(group.render())
+            return group
+        if c in "^$":
+            self.i += 1
+            return _Opaque(c)
+        if c in "*+?{":
+            if c == "{" and not re.compile(r"\{\d*,?\d*\}").match(text, self.i):
+                self.i += 1
+                return _Atom("\\{")
+            raise ValueError("nothing to repeat")
+        self.i += 1
+        if c == ".":
+            return _Atom(".")
+        return _Atom(re.escape(c) if c in "{}" else c)
+
+
+def _single(item):
+    """Unwrap trivial non-capturing groups around one item."""
+    while (isinstance(item, _Group) and item.opening == "(?:"
+           and len(item.alternatives) == 1
+           and len(item.alternatives[0]) == 1):
+        item = item.alternatives[0][0]
+    return item
+
+
+def _repeat_of_atom(item):
+    """Return (atom, low, high) for X, X*, X+, X?, X{m,n} with X one char."""
+    item = _single(item)
+    if isinstance(item, _Atom):
+        return item, 1, 1
+    if isinstance(item, _Repeat) and item.suffix != "+":
+        inner = _single(item.item)
+        if isinstance(inner, _Atom):
+            return inner, item.low, item.high
+    return None
+
+
+def _class_body(atom: _Atom) -> str | None:
+    text = atom.text
+    if text.startswith("[^"):
+        return None
+    if text.startswith("["):
+        return text[1:-1]
+    if text == ".":
+        return None
+    if text.startswith("\\"):
+        return text
+    return re.escape(text) if text in "\\]^-[" else text
+
+
+def _union(atoms: list) -> str | None:
+    """A single-character matcher accepting the union of the atoms."""
+    chars = frozenset().union(*(a.chars for a in atoms))
+    for atom in atoms:
+        if atom.chars == chars:
+            return atom.text
+    kept = [a for a in atoms
+            if not any(b.chars > a.chars for b in atoms)]
+    seen: list = []
+    for atom in kept:
+        if all(atom.chars != b.chars for b in seen):
+            seen.append(atom)
+    bodies = [_class_body(a) for a in seen]
+    if any(b is None for b in bodies):
+        missing = [c for c in _PROBE if c not in chars]
+        if not missing:
+            return "[\\s\\S]"
+        if len(missing) <= 8:
+            text = "[^" + "".join(re.escape(c) for c in missing) + "]"
+            try:
+                if _Atom(text).chars == chars:
+                    return text
+            except re.error:
+                return None
+        return None
+    body = "".join(bodies)
+    if body.startswith("^"):
+        body = "\\" + body
+    return "[" + body + "]"
+
+
+def _quant(low: int, high: int | None) -> str:
+    if (low, high) == (0, None):
+        return "*"
+    if (low, high) == (1, None):
+        return "+"
+    if (low, high) == (0, 1):
+        return "?"
+    if high is None:
+        return "{%d,}" % low
+    if low == high:
+        return "" if low == 1 else "{%d}" % low
+    return "{%d,%d}" % (low, high)
+
+
+def _wrap(group: _Group, body: str, nullable_outer: bool) -> str:
+    """Re-attach the capture of `group` (if any) around an unambiguous body."""
+    if group.opening == "(?:":
+        if nullable_outer:
+            return "(?:" + body + ")?"
+        return body
+    return group.opening + body + (")?" if nullable_outer else ")")
+
+
+def _closure_candidates(rep: _Repeat) -> list[str]:
+    """Rewrites of (alt|alt|...)* and (x+y?)+ style repeated groups."""
+    group = rep.item
+    if not isinstance(group, _Group) or rep.high is not None:
+        return []
+    if rep.low not in (0, 1):
+        return []
+    lazy = "?" if rep.suffix == "?" else ""
+    candidates = []
+    # 1. every alternative is built from single characters of a covered set
+    singles, nullable, covered = [], False, True
+    multi: list = []
+    for alternative in group.alternatives:
+        parts = [_repeat_of_atom(e) for e in alternative]
+        if not alternative or any(p is None for p in parts):
+            covered = False
+            break
+        if len(parts) == 1 and parts[0][1] <= 1 and parts[0][2] in (1, None):
+            singles.append(parts[0][0])
+        else:
+            multi.extend(p[0] for p in parts)
+        if all(p[1] == 0 for p in parts):
+            nullable = True
+    if covered and singles:
+        allowed = frozenset().union(*(a.chars for a in singles))
+        if all(a.chars <= allowed for a in multi):
+            union = _union(singles)
+            if union is not None:
+                q = "*" if rep.low == 0 or nullable else "+"
+                if group.opening == "(?:":
+                    candidates.append(union + q + lazy)
+                else:
+                    candidates.append(group.opening + union + q + lazy + ")")
+    # 2. one alternative made of two repeated single-character parts
+    if len(group.alternatives) == 1 and len(group.alternatives[0]) == 2:
+        first = _repeat_of_atom(group.alternatives[0][0])
+        second = _repeat_of_atom(group.alternatives[0][1])
+        if first and second:
+            (x, xl, xh), (y, yl, yh) = first, second
+            xt, yt = x.text, y.text
+            both = _union([x, y]) or "(?:%s|%s)" % (xt, yt)
+            outer = rep.low == 0
+            bodies = []
+            if (xl, xh) == (1, None) and (yl, yh) == (0, 1):
+                bodies.append(f"{xt}+(?:{yt}{xt}+)*{yt}?")
+            if (xl, xh) == (0, 1) and (yl, yh) == (1, None):
+                bodies.append(f"{xt}?{yt}+(?:{xt}{yt}+)*")
+            if (xl, xh) == (1, None) and (yl, yh) == (0, None):
+                bodies.append(f"{xt}{both}*")
+            if (xl, xh) == (0, None) and (yl, yh) == (1, None):
+                bodies.append(f"{both}*{yt}")
+            if (xl, xh) == (1, None) and (yl, yh) == (1, None):
+                bodies.append(f"{xt}{both}*{yt}")
+            if (xl, xh) == (0, None) and (yl, yh) == (0, None):
+                bodies.append(f"{both}*")
+                outer = False
+            for body in bodies:
+                candidates.append(_wrap(group, body, outer))
+    # 3. (a* s a*)+ : one separator surrounded by optional runs
+    if len(group.alternatives) == 1 and len(group.alternatives[0]) == 3:
+        parts = [_repeat_of_atom(e) for e in group.alternatives[0]]
+        if all(parts):
+            (a, al, ah), (m, ml, mh), (b, bl, bh) = parts
+            if ((al, ah) == (0, None) and (bl, bh) == (0, None)
+                    and a.chars == b.chars):
+                if (ml, mh) == (1, 1):
+                    body = f"{a.text}*(?:{m.text}{a.text}*)+"
+                    candidates.append(_wrap(group, body, rep.low == 0))
+                if (ml, mh) == (1, None):
+                    both = _union([a, m]) or f"(?:{a.text}|{m.text})"
+                    body = f"{a.text}*{m.text}{both}*"
+                    candidates.append(_wrap(group, body, rep.low == 0))
+    # 4. (x{m,n})+ : a bounded run inside an unbounded repeat
+    if len(group.alternatives) == 1 and len(group.alternatives[0]) == 1:
+        part = _repeat_of_atom(group.alternatives[0][0])
+        if part and part[1] >= 1:
+            x, low, _ = part
+            body = x.text + _quant(low, None)
+            candidates.append(_wrap(group, body, rep.low == 0))
+    return candidates
+
+
+def _pair_candidates(a, b, sep=None) -> list[str]:
+    """Rewrites of overlapping neighbours such as \\d+\\d* or \\d+\\.?\\d+."""
+    first, second = _repeat_of_atom(a), _repeat_of_atom(b)
+    if not first or not second:
+        return []
+    (x, xl, xh), (y, yl, yh) = first, second
+    if xh is not None or yh is not None or xl > 1 or yl > 1:
+        return []
+    xt, yt = x.text, y.text
+    q = {0: "*", 1: "+"}
+    if sep is None:
+        if not x.chars & y.chars:
+            return []
+        out = []
+        if x.chars <= y.chars:
+            out.append((xt + yt + q[yl]) if xl else (yt + q[yl]))
+        if y.chars <= x.chars:
+            out.append((xt + q[xl] + yt) if yl else (xt + q[xl]))
+        return out
+    s = _repeat_of_atom(sep)
+    if (not s or s[1:] not in ((0, 1), (0, None)) or x.chars != y.chars
+            or s[0].chars & x.chars):
+        return []
+    st = s[0].text + ("+" if s[2] is None else "")
+    table = {
+        (0, 0): f"{xt}*(?:{st}{xt}*)?",
+        (1, 1): f"{xt}+(?:{st}{xt}+|{xt})",
+        (1, 0): f"{xt}+(?:{st}{xt}*)?",
+        (0, 1): f"(?:{xt}*{st})?{xt}+",
+    }
+    return [table[(xl, yl)]]
+
+
+def _sequence_candidates(items: list) -> list[str]:
+    candidates = []
+    for k, item in enumerate(items):
+        if isinstance(item, _Repeat):
+            for c in _closure_candidates(item):
+                candidates.append(_render_sequence(items[:k]) + c
+                                  + _render_sequence(items[k + 1:]))
+    for k in range(len(items) - 1):
+        for c in _pair_candidates(items[k], items[k + 1]):
+            candidates.append(_render_sequence(items[:k]) + c
+                              + _render_sequence(items[k + 2:]))
+    for k in range(len(items) - 2):
+        for c in _pair_candidates(items[k], items[k + 2], items[k + 1]):
+            candidates.append(_render_sequence(items[:k]) + c
+                              + _render_sequence(items[k + 3:]))
+    # x+(y?x+)*  ->  x+(?:yx+)*
+    for k in range(len(items) - 1):
+        head, rep = _repeat_of_atom(items[k]), items[k + 1]
+        if (head and head[1:] == (1, None) and isinstance(rep, _Repeat)
+                and isinstance(rep.item, _Group) and rep.high is None
+                and len(rep.item.alternatives) == 1
+                and len(rep.item.alternatives[0]) == 2):
+            y = _repeat_of_atom(rep.item.alternatives[0][0])
+            x = _repeat_of_atom(rep.item.alternatives[0][1])
+            if x and y and x[1:] == (1, None) and y[1:] == (0, 1):
+                xt, yt = head[0].text, y[0].text
+                for body in (f"{xt}+(?:{yt}{xt}+)*", f"{xt}(?:{yt}?{xt})+"):
+                    if rep.item.opening != "(?:":
+                        body = rep.item.opening + body + ")"
+                    candidates.insert(0, _render_sequence(items[:k]) + body
+                                      + _render_sequence(items[k + 2:]))
+    # separated list: (x+y?)*x+  ->  x+(?:yx+)*
+    for k in range(len(items) - 1):
+        rep, tail = items[k], _repeat_of_atom(items[k + 1])
+        if (isinstance(rep, _Repeat) and isinstance(rep.item, _Group)
+                and rep.high is None and rep.low in (0, 1) and tail
+                and tail[1:] == (1, None)
+                and len(rep.item.alternatives) == 1
+                and len(rep.item.alternatives[0]) == 2):
+            x = _repeat_of_atom(rep.item.alternatives[0][0])
+            y = _repeat_of_atom(rep.item.alternatives[0][1])
+            if x and y and x[1:] == (1, None) and y[1:] == (0, 1):
+                xt, yt = x[0].text, y[0].text
+                for body in (f"{xt}+(?:{yt}{xt}+)*", f"{xt}(?:{yt}?{xt})+"):
+                    if rep.item.opening != "(?:":
+                        body = rep.item.opening + body + ")"
+                    candidates.insert(0, _render_sequence(items[:k]) + body
+                                      + _render_sequence(items[k + 2:]))
+    return candidates
+
+
+def _candidates(alternatives: list) -> list[str]:
+    out = []
+    for k, items in enumerate(alternatives):
+        for c in _sequence_candidates(items):
+            alts = [_render_sequence(e) for e in alternatives]
+            alts[k] = c
+            out.append("|".join(alts))
+    return out
+
+
+def _equivalent(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
+    try:
+        ra, rb = re.compile(a), re.compile(b)
+    except re.error:
+        return False
+    if ra.groups != rb.groups:
